data.indexFullNameEn: CSI Brand Name Drug Industry Index
data.indexCnDesc: 中证创新药产业指数从主营业务涉及创新药研发的上市公司证券中，选取不超过50只最具代表性上市公司证券作为指数样本，以反映创新药产业上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI Brand Name Drug Industry Index is composed of no more than 50 A-Share securities which engaged R&D of Brand Name Drug as the constituents. The index is to measure the performance of the Brand Name Drug industry.
